infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro uses your location to discover nearby sports card shows, conventions, and local dealer trade events.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro uses the camera to scan raw and graded sports cards, barcodes, and slabs to instantly identify player details, look up real-time pricing comps, and add cards to your inventory.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro accesses your photo library to let you upload sports card photos for AI valuation, customize your dealer profile avatar, and attach transaction receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro needs permission to save generated card comps, deal receipts, and invoices to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro uses your microphone to enable voice search and hands-free card lookup.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: RSL Cards Pro uses speech recognition to convert spoken queries into card search terms.
